title: Adjust global header navigation and add Home-page Discuss & Engage links

requirements.summary: Update global header top-right navigation to show only Home and About, removing Read/Share/Reviews/Comments.
acceptanceCriteria: On all pages, the top header shows navigation links/buttons for "Home" (routes to "/") and "About" (routes to "/about") aligned on the top-right side of the header.
The top header no longer shows "Read", "Share" (or "Share Story"), "Reviews", or "Comments" navigation items.
Header layout remains responsive and usable on mobile and desktop (no overflow/cutoff).

file_operations.description: Replace the current header navigation buttons (Read/Share/Reviews/Comments) with only two top-right navigation controls: Home (to "/") and About (to "/about"). Keep the header responsive (e.g., compact spacing on small screens) while preserving existing branding on the left. Use existing shadcn-ui Button and TanStack Router Link/navigate patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a Home-page Discuss & Engage section linking to Discussions in reviews/comments modes.
acceptanceCriteria: The Home page contains a clearly labeled "Discuss & Engage" section below the hero/top area (i.e., not in the header).
The section includes a "Reviews" control that navigates to "/discussions" with search param mode set to "reviews".
The section includes a "Comments" control that navigates to "/discussions" with search param mode set to "comments".
There are no "Reviews" or "Comments" navigation items remaining in the top header.

file_operations.description: Add a distinct, clearly labeled "Discuss & Engage" section below the hero/top area that contains two controls: "Reviews" (navigate to "/discussions" with search { mode: 'reviews' }) and "Comments" (navigate to "/discussions" with search { mode: 'comments' }). Compose with existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button) without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
